partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester — the strongest profile researched so far for the validate-then-refer motion. Sentry is a young, founder-led boutique that explicitly built its audit methodology around automation tools (Drata) and sells '70% less client effort,' so a pre-audit AWS readiness scan that reduces evidence churn extends their core pitch rather than competing with it. The RISCPoint affiliation is a bonus: it adds a cloud-engineering/FedRAMP-fluent advisory arm that can absorb remediation work LoxeAI scans surface, and gives two referral surfaces (Sentry for attest, RISCPoint for advisory). Best-fit entry: get Jake Nix (AWS-certified CPA co-founder) to run a sandbox scan and act as the technical validator.
pitch_note: You built Sentry's audit process ground-up around tools like Drata so lean SaaS teams aren't buried in evidence requests — LoxeAI attacks the same problem one step earlier, scanning a startup's AWS environment for SOC 2 readiness gaps before they ever engage an auditor. Since you hold the AWS Cloud Practitioner cert yourself, we'd love 30 minutes to have you run the scan against a sandbox account and tear apart the findings. If it holds up to your bar, your pre-audit pipeline gets a simple play: 'run this scan first — it gets you 80% ready,' meaning cleaner fieldwork for your team and faster Type 1s for your SMB clients.
